window23_loot_blocker.scope_decision: native_gameplay.py is outside this lane's named production files (scripts.py only), so the decode fix is NOT made here. The minimal tracker-lane fix: ingest 0x009D (size 17 in _validate) into self._floor with the <HIHBHHHBB> layout, keeping the 0x0ADD branch for other pins. The overlay decodes 0x009D from raw frames independently, so window 23's receipt shows floor sight + XP deltas regardless; only pickup_dispatched depends on the tracker fix.
window23_loot_blocker.honest_fallback: Without the tracker fix the window-23 receipt records pickup_dispatched:false plus floor_items_seen>0 sight events - a named blocker, not fabricated zeros.
